title: Adjuster Bulletin: Release and Forfeiture of Withheld Depreciation on HomeGuard Claims
content:
When a HomeGuard Homeowners Policy claim payment is made at actual cash value, the depreciation withheld from it is recoverable depreciation. It is released only against documented completion of the repair or replacement of the damaged property of that coverage part.

## The recovery period

The holdback is released only when the proof of completed repair or replacement is received no later than the depreciation recovery period that starts on the date of the initial actual-cash-value payment.

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| Date the period starts from | The date of the initial actual-cash-value payment from which the depreciation was withheld, as recorded on the claim file |
| Unit | Calendar days |
| Last day | That payment date plus the package's depreciation recovery days |
| Proof received on the last day | On time |
| Holdback still remaining when the period ends | Forfeited, in one forfeiture entry for the remainder |

A holdback that has been forfeited can no longer be released.

*Boundary cases (hypothetical).* Proof of completed repair received on the last day of the period supports a release. Proof received on the day after the last day does not, and whatever holdback remains at the end of the period is forfeited.

## Amount of a release

The release equals the smaller of:

1. the holdback still remaining on that holdback entry; and
2. the documented incurred cost, capped at the replacement-cost value, less the actual cash value (the replacement-cost value less the depreciation);

and it is never below 0.00.

Several partial releases may be made against one holdback as items are completed, each on its own proof. Each release issues a recoverable depreciation payment under the same payee rule as the original payment.

## Worked releases (hypothetical figures)

A part with a replacement-cost value of 20000 USD and depreciation of 5000 USD has an actual cash value of 15000 USD, and 5000 USD is withheld.

| Documented incurred cost | Capped cost | Capped cost less actual cash value | Holdback remaining | Release |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 18000 | 18000 | 3000 | 5000 | 3000 |
| 22000 | 20000 | 5000 | 5000 | 5000 |
| 14000 | 14000 | below 0 | 5000 | 0.00 |

After the first row's release of 3000 USD, the holdback remaining on the entry is 2000 USD; a later proof showing a further completed item can release no more than that 2000 USD.
